Āśramopaniṣad
Has four sections on the four āśramas. See Col. Jacob's edn. of 11 [Page212-b] Atharvaṇa Upaniṣads, p.. 155-57 an. N. S. Press edn. of 120 Upaniṣads, p.. 651-2. In some mss. it is called Bhikṣukoº an. has the fourth section on sannyāsa alone with slight differences; see N. S. Press edn. 120 Upaniṣads, p.. 426-7. Adyar Library Ed.. Sannyāsa Upaniṣads, p.. 190-2.
Jacob's Ed.. assigns it to Av., but in the Adyar edition the commentator Upaniṣadbrahmendra assigns it to Ś. Yv. See also above, NCC. I. p. 87a in the collection Ath. Vedāntargata Upaniṣadah2 an. below under Bhikṣukoº.
